title: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:
summary: Sangat is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
lifeApplication: Move closer to one company that helps the heart tell the truth. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Sangat becomes more truthful when siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:.

evidence.turn: Sangat steadies when may I never forget You, Lord. This soul, body and breath are Yours.
evidence.practicalImplication: Move closer to one company that helps the heart tell the truth. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
